<?php

function visit(string $prefix, array $used, int &$counter): void
{
    $characters = 'ABCD';
    if (strlen($prefix) === 4) {
        $counter++;
        printf("%d: %s\n", $counter, $prefix);
        return;
    }
    for ($i = 0; $i < 4; $i++) {
        if (!$used[$i]) {
            $used[$i] = true;
            visit($prefix . $characters[$i], $used, $counter);
            $used[$i] = false;
        }
    }
}

$counter = 0;
visit('', array_fill(0, 4, false), $counter);
